sources.publication_or_effective_date: Change dated 2023-09-27; ASSIST metadata updated 2026-08-28; next review due 2028-09-25
sources.scope: System-safety standard prioritizing hazard elimination where practicable, mitigation and testing of remaining hazards, cross-domain impact awareness, and explicit residual-risk management under applicable DoD or contractual authority.
sources.degs_use: Supports the local hazard-control hierarchy, failure-path evidence, cross-domain checks, and named human residual-risk ownership without copying a military severity matrix.
sources.normative_weight: TIER A — final military standard within invoked government or contractual scope
sources.limitations: Applies only within its stated or contractually invoked scope. Distribution Statement A is not an open-content license, and DEGS is not a military system-safety program or accredited equivalent.
sources.licensing: Distribution Statement A permits public distribution but is not an open-content license
sources.access: OFFICIAL ASSIST METADATA AND PUBLIC DOCUMENT ACCESS

sources.title: DoDM 5000.101, Operational Test and Evaluation and Live Fire Test and Evaluation of Artificial Intelligence-Enabled and Autonomous Systems
sources.scope: DoD manual for covered AI and autonomous systems addressing independent test sets, operationally representative and out-of-distribution conditions, adversarial attacks, integrated human-machine testing, emergent and negative behavior, error consequences, poisoning and extraction threats, drift, safer modes, and monitoring.
sources.degs_use: Informs proportional independent fixtures, adversarial and negative tests, distribution-shift cases, failure-consequence analysis, fallback modes, integrated human-agent-tool tests, and monitoring.
sources.normative_weight: TIER A — current DoD manual within stated applicability
sources.limitations: Authoritative only within the manual's stated DoD test-and-evaluation scope. Military operational-test ceremony and terminology do not automatically apply to low-consequence engineering, and no DoD accreditation is implied.
sources.licensing: CLEARED FOR PUBLIC RELEASE; NO OPEN-CONTENT LICENSE ESTABLISHED
